title: PAIR OF BIRD EARRINGS
findings: Pair of long gilt-metal drop earrings set with Italian micromosaic panels: doves on blue ground with flowers, pair of swans in roundels, pink side panels. Close crop shows fine glass tesserae filaments, so genuine micromosaic rather than printed or enamel. Twisted wire borders and scroll mounts in a Victorian Roman revival style; matte gilt finish suggests probably mid to late 20th century Italian work rather than 19th century Grand Tour, but antique cannot be ruled out from one photo. Catalogue calls them only 'bird earrings', so under-described. No marks visible (backs not photographed).
condition: Mosaic surfaces appear intact, no visible lost tesserae; gilt bright. Backs and fittings not shown.
reason: Under-described Italian micromosaic drop earrings; if 19th century could make several hundred, 20th century versions still sell $100-250.
